title: More Lil Guys
description: Makes more blocks into lil guys.
body:
We love lil block guys, like the Observer, Dropper, Crafter, and Dispenser. But what if we had more lil block guys? Well, this pack adds more lil block guys. Just in case you needed more lil block guys.

![The Jukebox with all vanilla lil block guys](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/nTDcb7uF/images/7635922bb5b3c1526c9a0d1ab6c5d3c72e4fe320.png)
